_note: Vocabulary Trees (Design Doc 4.5, Technical Design Doc 2.4). One tree per clue category in clues_master.json - see docs/adr/002-vocabulary-trees-follow-clue-categories.md for why these are not the Science/History/Arts/Nature trees the design doc names. Supported effect types: damage_multiplier, timer_bonus, heal_on_solve, ink_bonus (per letter), chain_duration, chain_bonus (ink per chain), damage_reduction. Only max_rank 1 is supported. Prerequisites must form a DAG.
